initial_test_run: First run: the plain-text fixture failed (its header line has no label column, so naive cell positions misaligned); plain-text cells now keep character offsets and headers align by overlap. Five lifecycle tests then failed because the frozen Cache does not create its root; the probe now creates attempts/<id>/source first. 'Three and Six Months Ended' parsed as six months; a shared-duration rule fixed it. A review before freezing then made these changes, each covered by a new or updated test (written with the change, not run against the earlier code): the attempt check moved under the study lock, a projection interrupted before it was written is completed on resume, --reanalyze accepts only a complete attempt of the frozen definition, an equal value is dropped as a different period only on a contradicting end date or duration (otherwise period_unverified), a bare year-to-date header takes the 10-Q's year-to-date length, plain-text headers skip section labels, table context is limited to text since the previous table, and a stacked mid-table period header starts a new header block. The frozen-identity test failed until freeze.json existed; then all 31 passed. Before that freeze was published, the Codex review of the previous push raised nine findings, addressed with new tests and a re-freeze: an unsigned amount under a 'net loss' or 'cash used' label is negative (one new assertion first failed because an unsigned amount was accepted with either sign; the rule now makes it negative only) and 'Net (loss) income' labels match; narrative amounts pair with the label and period of their own clause, and a clause naming an excluded measure does not count; rowspan is expanded; the spot-check membership rule is declared; a header missing identity fields is identity_unverified (lower bound only) rather than identity_failed; ambiguous releases and currency_mismatch no longer count in the upper bound by themselves. The header-identity test failed once as expected when a missing acceptance moved from issues to missing; then all 35 passed. Second review round (on the published freeze 67529c4c), nine findings, each covered by a new or updated test and followed by a re-freeze: possibly stated outcomes (an unreadable or image-only candidate) now outrank label_only when documents are matched jointly; a statement image counts even after a label appears elsewhere, with stricter statement names; release identification reads text in source order; evidence carries each exhibit's SHA256; summary.json reports per-component shares and Wilson intervals; prose amounts accept USD before or after and a leading minus; several distinct years in one clause with several amounts are period_unverified; <sup> footnote text is dropped; and other Python processes running anything under .qualification refuse the start (listed with ps or PowerShell Get-CimInstance; the Windows path is exercised only with a mocked listing here). The new tests passed on their first run; then all 41 passed.
